name: Griffith Ramen Danbo Business Scholarship (Japanese students)
summary: $5,000 tuition scholarship for a continuing Japanese international student in Griffith's Bachelor of Business or International Tourism and Hotel Management.
who: Full-time continuing student in Bachelor of Business or Bachelor of International Tourism and Hotel Management in Trimester 1 2027
Minimum GPA of 4.0 in current Griffith program
how: Apply by the closing date with a personal statement of up to 500 words

source.label: Griffith University: Ramen Danbo Business Scholarship

evidence.quote: Be an International student with Japanese citizenship.
Have a minimum GPA (Grade point average) in current program of study at Griffith of 4.0 or above
